end.summary:
Dev practised examples of traditional nature-protecting communities and practices.
Dev identified Bishnoi people in Rajasthan and Amrita Devi’s tree-protection action.
Dev explained that sacred groves are forest areas left undisturbed.
Dev explained that roots hold soil and help prevent rainwater from carrying it away.
Dev did not complete the teach-back independently.
end.parentNote: Dev practised Bishnoi, sacred groves, and ways roots protect soil. Dev used the idea that roots hold soil and later connected this to preventing rainwater from carrying soil away. Dev first mixed up some root functions, and corrected the soil-holding idea later in the lesson. At home, ask Dev to explain one example each for Bishnoi, sacred groves, and the Chipko movement.
